title: Grocery List
instruction: Create a list of 3 items and print the first and last element.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Grocery List

items = ["Eggs", "Milk", "Bread"]

title: Inventory
instruction: Append a new item to an inventory list and print total length.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Inventory

inv = ["Shield", "Laser"]
inv.append("Scanner")
print("Inventory:", inv)
print("Count:", len(inv))

title: Playlist Manager
instruction: Remove a track from a playlist, sort the tracks alphabetically, and print the updated list.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Playlist Manager

playlist = ["Starwaves", "Cosmic Drift", "Astral Echo"]
playlist.remove("Cosmic Drift")
playlist.sort()
print("Sorted Playlist:", playlist)

title: High Scores Analytics
instruction: Given a list of player scores, compute and print the highest score, lowest score, and average score.
initialCode:
# Exercise: High Scores Analytics

scores = [88, 95, 72, 100, 64]
highest = max(scores)
lowest = min(scores)
average = sum(scores) / len(scores)

print(f"Highest: {highest}, Lowest: {lowest}, Avg: {average}")
